description:
Cross-tabulation aggregation grouped by one dimension

Returns record counts filtered by any combination of archive, source type, event type, event place and year range, grouped by ONE chosen dimension (archive, sourcetype, eventtype, place or year). Use this endpoint to answer questions such as "how many Bidprentjes per archive?" or "how many marriages per year in Amsterdam?". The response includes the total filtered record count, the total number of distinct groups (capped at 750) and the top-N groups according to the chosen sort.
name: get_breakdown

outputSchema.description: Cross-tabulation result returned by `/stats/breakdown.json`. Records matching the supplied filters are aggregated on the dimension chosen by `group_by`.

filters.description: Echoes the filter parameters supplied by the caller. Only filters actually present in the request are echoed; defaults are not.

group_by.description: Dimension on which the results are grouped.

results.description: Top-N groups according to the chosen sort, truncated to `number_show`.

items.description: One group within a breakdown response.

count.description: Number of records in this group after filters are applied.

key.description: Raw facet value identifying the group. For `archive` this is the archive_code; for `sourcetype` and `eventtype` it is the Dutch raw value; for `place` it is the place name; for `year` it is the year as a string.

label.description: Human-readable label, localised when `lang` is supplied. Only present for `archive`, `sourcetype` and `eventtype` groupings.

total_groups.description: Total distinct groups matching `min_count`. Capped at 750 (the SOLR_FACET_MAX limit). When this equals 750 the true number of groups may be higher.

total_records.description: Total number of records matching the supplied filters.

title: Breakdown Stats
